verses.original: δὲ Τῇ μιᾷ τῶν σαββάτων βαθέως ὄρθρου ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸ μνῆμα φέρουσαι ἀρώματα ἃ ἡτοίμασαν
verses.transliteration: de Tē mia tōn sabbatōn batheōs orthrou ēlthon epi to mnēma pherousai arōmata ha hētoimasan
verses.literal: - On the first [day] of the week very early in the morning [the women] came to the tomb bringing [the] spices - they had prepared

verses.original: δὲ εὗρον τὸν λίθον ἀποκεκυλισμένον ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου
verses.transliteration: de heuron ton lithon apokekylismenon apo tou mnēmeiou
verses.literal: - They found the stone rolled away from the tomb

verses.original: δὲ εἰσελθοῦσαι οὐχ εὗρον τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: de eiselthousai ouch heuron to sōma tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: but when they entered vvv they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτὰς τῷ ἀπορεῖσθαι περὶ τούτου καὶ ἰδοὺ δύο ἄνδρες ἐν ἀστραπτούσῃ ἐσθῆτι ἐπέστησαν αὐταῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en autas tō aporeisthai peri toutou kai idou dyo andres en astraptousē esthēti epestēsan autais
verses.literal: vvv vvv While they - were puzzling over this - suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν καὶ κλινουσῶν τὰ πρόσωπα εἰς τὴν γῆν γενομένων ἐμφόβων εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτάς Τί ζητεῖτε τὸν ζῶντα μετὰ τῶν νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: de autōn kai klinousōn ta prosōpa eis tēn gēn genomenōn emphobōn eipan pros autas Ti zēteite ton zōnta meta tōn nekrōn
verses.literal: As [the women] - bowed [their] faces to the ground vvv in terror [the two men] asked . . . them Why do you look for the living among the dead

verses.original: ἔστιν οὐκ ὧδε ἀλλὰ ἠγέρθη μνήσθητε ὡς ἐλάλησεν ὑμῖν ὢν ἔτι ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ
verses.transliteration: estin ouk hōde alla ēgerthē mnēsthēte hōs elalēsen hymin ōn eti en tē Galilaia
verses.literal: He is not here - He has risen Remember how He told you while He was still in - Galilee

verses.original: λέγων ὅτι Τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου δεῖ παραδοθῆναι εἰς χεῖρας ἁμαρτωλῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ σταυρωθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀναστῆναι
verses.transliteration: legōn hoti Ton Huion tou anthrōpou dei paradothēnai eis cheiras hamartōlōn anthrōpōn kai staurōthēnai kai tē tritē hēmera anastēnai
verses.literal: - - The Son - of Man must be delivered into [the] hands of sinful men and be crucified and on the third day rise again

verses.original: Καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν αὐτοῦ τῶν ῥημάτων
verses.transliteration: Kai emnēsthēsan autou tōn rhēmatōn
verses.literal: Then they remembered His - words

verses.original: καὶ ὑποστρέψασαι ἀπὸ τοῦ μνημείου ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα ταῦτα τοῖς ἕνδεκα καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς λοιποῖς
verses.transliteration: kai hypostrepsasai apo tou mnēmeiou apēngeilan panta tauta tois hendeka kai pasin tois loipois
verses.literal: And when they returned from the tomb they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others

verses.original: δὲ ἦσαν ἡ Μαρία Μαγδαληνὴ καὶ Ἰωάννα καὶ Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου καὶ αἱ λοιπαὶ σὺν αὐταῖς ἔλεγον ταῦτα πρὸς τοὺς ἀποστόλους
verses.transliteration: de ēsan hē Maria Magdalēnē kai Iōanna kai Maria hē Iakōbou kai hai loipai syn autais elegon tauta pros tous apostolous
verses.literal: - It was - Mary Magdalene - Joanna - Mary the [mother] of James and the other women with them [who] told [this] to the apostles

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ῥήματα ἐφάνησαν ὡσεὶ λῆρος ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν καὶ ἠπίστουν αὐταῖς
verses.transliteration: kai tauta ta rhēmata ephanēsan hōsei lēros enōpion autōn kai ēpistoun autais
verses.literal: But their - words seemed like nonsense to them and they did not believe [the women]

verses.original: Ὁ Πέτρος δὲ ἀναστὰς ἔδραμεν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ παρακύψας βλέπει μόνα τὰ ὀθόνια καὶ ἀπῆλθεν θαυμάζων πρὸς αὑτὸν τὸ γεγονός
verses.transliteration: Ho Petros de anastas edramen epi to mnēmeion kai parakypsas blepei mona ta othonia kai apēlthen thaumazōn pros hauton to gegonos
verses.literal: - Peter however got up [and] ran to the tomb And [after] bending down [and] seeing only the linen cloths - he went away wondering to himself what had happened

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ ἡμέρᾳ δύο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἦσαν πορευόμενοι εἰς κώμην ᾗ ὄνομα Ἐμμαοῦς ἑξήκοντα σταδίους ἀπέχουσαν ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: Kai idou en tē autē hēmera dyo ex autōn ēsan poreuomenoi eis kōmēn hē onoma Emmaous hexēkonta stadious apechousan apo Ierousalēm
verses.literal: vvv vvv vvv That same day two of them were going to a village vvv called Emmaus about seven miles . . . . . . from Jerusalem

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ ὡμίλουν πρὸς ἀλλήλους περὶ πάντων τούτων τῶν συμβεβηκότων
verses.transliteration: kai autoi hōmiloun pros allēlous peri pantōn toutōn tōn symbebēkotōn
verses.literal: - They were talking with each other about everything . . . that had happened

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτοὺς τῷ ὁμιλεῖν καὶ συζητεῖν καὶ Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς ἐγγίσας συνεπορεύετο αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en autous tō homilein kai syzētein kai Iēsous autos engisas syneporeueto autois
verses.literal: And as - they - talked and deliberated - Jesus Himself came up [and] walked along with them

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἐκρατοῦντο μὴ τοῦ ἐπιγνῶναι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de autōn hoi ophthalmoi ekratounto mē tou epignōnai auton
verses.literal: But their - eyes were kept . . . - from recognizing Him

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τίνες οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι οὓς ἀντιβάλλετε πρὸς ἀλλήλους περιπατοῦντες Καὶ ἐστάθησαν σκυθρωποί
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros autous Tines houtoi hoi logoi hous antiballete pros allēlous peripatountes Kai estathēsan skythrōpoi
verses.literal: - He asked - them What vvv vvv vvv vvv are you discussing so intently . . . . . . as you walk along - They stood still with sadness on their faces

verses.original: δὲ εἷς ὀνόματι Κλεοπᾶς ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Σὺ μόνος παροικεῖς Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνως τὰ γενόμενα ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν ταύταις ταῖς ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: de heis onomati Kleopas apokritheis eipen pros auton Sy monos paroikeis Ierousalēm kai ouk egnōs ta genomena en autē en tautais tais hēmerais
verses.literal: - One [of them] named Cleopas asked . . . . . . Him {Are} You the only visitor to Jerusalem [who] {does} not know the things that have happened vvv [there] in recent - days

verses.original: Ποῖα Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τὰ περὶ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ναζαρηνοῦ Δὲ οἱ εἶπαν αὐτῷ ἀνὴρ ὃς ἐγένετο προφήτης δυνατὸς ἐν λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ ἐναντίον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: Poia Kai eipen autois Ta peri Iēsou tou Nazarēnou De hoi eipan autō anēr hos egeneto prophētēs dynatos en logō kai ergō enantion tou Theou kai pantos tou laou
verses.literal: What things - He asked - The events involving Jesus of Nazareth - - they answered - [This] man - was a prophet powerful in speech and action before - God and all the people

verses.original: τε ὅπως οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ ἡμῶν ἄρχοντες παρέδωκαν αὐτὸν εἰς κρίμα θανάτου καὶ ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: te hopōs hoi archiereis kai hoi hēmōn archontes paredōkan auton eis krima thanatou kai estaurōsan auton
verses.literal: - - [Our] chief priests and - - rulers delivered Him up . . . to [the] sentence of death and they crucified Him

verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς ἠλπίζομεν ὅτι αὐτός ἐστιν ὁ μέλλων λυτροῦσθαι τὸν Ἰσραήλ ἀλλά καὶ γε σὺν πᾶσιν τούτοις ταύτην ἄγει τρίτην ἡμέραν ἀφ’ οὗ ταῦτα ἐγένετο
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis ēlpizomen hoti autos estin ho mellōn lytrousthai ton Israēl alla kai ge syn pasin toutois tautēn agei tritēn hēmeran aph’ hou tauta egeneto
verses.literal: But we were hoping - He was the [One who] would redeem - Israel - And besides - all [this] [it] is [the] third day since . . . these things took place

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ καὶ τινες ἐξ ἡμῶν γυναῖκές ἐξέστησαν ἡμᾶς γενόμεναι ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον ὀρθριναὶ
verses.transliteration: Alla kai tines ex hēmōn gynaikes exestēsan hēmas genomenai epi to mnēmeion orthrinai
verses.literal: Furthermore - some of our women astounded us They were at the tomb early this morning

verses.original: καὶ μὴ εὑροῦσαι αὐτοῦ τὸ σῶμα ἦλθον λέγουσαι ἑωρακέναι καὶ ὀπτασίαν ἀγγέλων οἳ λέγουσιν αὐτὸν ζῆν
verses.transliteration: kai mē heurousai autou to sōma ēlthon legousai heōrakenai kai optasian angelōn hoi legousin auton zēn
verses.literal: but vvv they did not find His - body They came [and] told [us] they had seen - a vision of angels who said that [Jesus] was alive

verses.original: καὶ τινες τῶν σὺν ἡμῖν ἀπῆλθόν ἐπὶ τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ εὗρον οὕτως καθὼς αἱ γυναῖκες καὶ εἶπον δὲ αὐτὸν οὐκ εἶδον
verses.transliteration: kai tines tōn syn hēmin apēlthon epi to mnēmeion kai heuron houtōs kathōs hai gynaikes kai eipon de auton ouk eidon
verses.literal: Then some of our companions . . . . . . went to the tomb and found [it] just as the women - had described But Him vvv they did not see

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ὦ ἀνόητοι καὶ βραδεῖς τῇ καρδίᾳ τοῦ πιστεύειν ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς οἱ προφῆται ἐλάλησαν
verses.transliteration: Kai autos eipen pros autous Ō anoētoi kai bradeis tē kardia tou pisteuein epi pasin hois hoi prophētai elalēsan
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] said to them O foolish [ones] and slow - of heart - to believe - all that the prophets have spoken

verses.original: οὐχὶ ἔδει τὸν Χριστὸν παθεῖν ταῦτα καὶ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν δόξαν
verses.transliteration: ouchi edei ton Christon pathein tauta kai eiselthein eis autou tēn doxan
verses.literal: vvv Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter . . . His - glory

verses.original: καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ Μωϋσέως καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν προφητῶν διερμήνευσεν αὐτοῖς τὰ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς γραφαῖς περὶ ἑαυτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai arxamenos apo Mōuseōs kai apo pantōn tōn prophētōn diermēneusen autois ta en pasais tais graphais peri heautou
verses.literal: And beginning with Moses and - all the Prophets He explained to them what [ was written ] in all the Scriptures about Himself

verses.original: Καὶ ἤγγισαν εἰς τὴν κώμην οὗ ἐπορεύοντο καὶ αὐτὸς προσεποιήσατο πορεύεσθαι πορρώτερον
verses.transliteration: Kai ēngisan eis tēn kōmēn hou eporeuonto kai autos prosepoiēsato poreuesthai porrōteron
verses.literal: As they approached . . . the village where they were headed - He seemed to be going farther

verses.original: καὶ παρεβιάσαντο αὐτὸν λέγοντες Μεῖνον μεθ’ ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐστὶν πρὸς ἑσπέραν καὶ ἤδη ἡ ἡμέρα κέκλικεν Καὶ εἰσῆλθεν τοῦ μεῖναι σὺν αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai parebiasanto auton legontes Meinon meth’ hēmōn hoti estin pros hesperan kai ēdē hē hēmera kekliken Kai eisēlthen tou meinai syn autois
verses.literal: But they pleaded with Him . . . . . . Stay with us for it is nearly evening and . . . the day is almost over So He went in - to stay with them

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτὸν τῷ κατακλιθῆναι μετ’ αὐτῶν λαβὼν τὸν ἄρτον εὐλόγησεν καὶ κλάσας ἐπεδίδου αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en auton tō kataklithēnai met’ autōn labōn ton arton eulogēsen kai klasas epedidou autois
verses.literal: While . . . . . . He - was reclining [at the table] with them He took - bread spoke a blessing and broke [it] [and] gave [it] to them

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ διηνοίχθησαν καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτόν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγένετο ἄφαντος ἀπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de autōn hoi ophthalmoi diēnoichthēsan kai epegnōsan auton kai autos egeneto aphantos ap’ autōn
verses.literal: Then their - eyes were opened and they recognized [Jesus] and He vvv disappeared from [their sight]

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους ἦν Οὐχὶ ἡμῶν ἡ καρδία καιομένη ἐν ἡμῖν ὡς ἐλάλει ἡμῖν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ὡς διήνοιγεν τὰς γραφάς ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kai eipan pros allēlous ēn Ouchi hēmōn hē kardia kaiomenē en hēmin hōs elalei hēmin en tē hodō hōs diēnoigen tas graphas hēmin
verses.literal: - They asked - each other Were not our - hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road [and] opened the Scriptures to us

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστάντες αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ καὶ εὗρον τοὺς ἕνδεκα καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτοῖς ἠθροισμένους
verses.transliteration: Kai anastantes autē tē hōra hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm kai heuron tous hendeka kai tous syn autois ēthroismenous
verses.literal: And they got up [that] very - hour [and] returned to Jerusalem [There] they found the Eleven and those with them gathered together

verses.original: λέγοντας ὅτι ὁ Κύριος Ὄντως ἠγέρθη καὶ ὤφθη Σίμωνι
verses.transliteration: legontas hoti ho Kyrios Ontōs ēgerthē kai ōphthē Simōni
verses.literal: [and] saying - The Lord vvv has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐξηγοῦντο τὰ ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ ὡς αὐτοῖς ἐγνώσθη ἐν τῇ κλάσει τοῦ ἄρτου
verses.transliteration: Kai autoi exēgounto ta en tē hodō kai hōs autois egnōsthē en tē klasei tou artou
verses.literal: Then [the two] told what had happened on the road and how they had recognized [Jesus] in the breaking of the bread

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν λαλούντων Ταῦτα αὐτὸς ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῶν καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Εἰρήνη ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de autōn lalountōn Tauta autos estē en mesō autōn kai legei autois Eirēnē hymin
verses.literal: While they were describing these [events] [Jesus] Himself stood vvv among them and said . . . Peace [be] with you

verses.original: δὲ πτοηθέντες καὶ γενόμενοι ἔμφοβοι ἐδόκουν θεωρεῖν πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: de ptoēthentes kai genomenoi emphoboi edokoun theōrein pneuma
verses.literal: But they were startled and vvv frightened thinking they had seen a spirit

verses.original: Τί ἐστέ τεταραγμένοι Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ διὰ τί διαλογισμοὶ ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐν ὑμῶν τῇ καρδίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Ti este tetaragmenoi Kai eipen autois kai dia ti dialogismoi anabainousin en hymōn tē kardia
verses.literal: Why are you troubled - [Jesus] asked . . . and why . . . {do} doubts arise in your - hearts

verses.original: ἴδετε μου τὰς χεῖράς καὶ μου τοὺς πόδας ὅτι εἰμι ἐγώ αὐτός ψηλαφήσατέ με καὶ ἴδετε ὅτι πνεῦμα οὐκ ἔχει σάρκα καὶ ὀστέα καθὼς θεωρεῖτε ἐμὲ ἔχοντα
verses.transliteration: idete mou tas cheiras kai mou tous podas hoti eimi egō autos psēlaphēsate me kai idete hoti pneuma ouk echei sarka kai ostea kathōs theōreite eme echonta
verses.literal: Look at My - hands and My - feet - It is I Myself Touch Me and see for a spirit {does} not have flesh and bones as you see I have

verses.original: καὶ εἰπὼν τοῦτο ἔδειξεν αὐτοῖς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ τοὺς πόδας
verses.transliteration: kai eipōn touto edeixen autois tas cheiras kai tous podas
verses.literal: And [when] He had said this He showed them [His] hands and - feet

verses.original: δὲ αὐτῶν Ἔτι ἀπιστούντων ἀπὸ τῆς χαρᾶς καὶ θαυμαζόντων εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἔχετέ τι ἐνθάδε βρώσιμον
verses.transliteration: de autōn Eti apistountōn apo tēs charas kai thaumazontōn eipen autois Echete ti enthade brōsimon
verses.literal: While they vvv were still in disbelief because of [their] joy and amazement He asked them Do you have anything here to eat

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἐπέδωκαν αὐτῷ μέρος ὀπτοῦ ἰχθύος
verses.transliteration: de hoi epedōkan autō meros optou ichthyos
verses.literal: So - they gave Him a piece of broiled fish

verses.original: καὶ λαβὼν ἔφαγεν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: kai labōn ephagen enōpion autōn
verses.literal: and He took [it] [and] ate [it] in front of them

verses.original: δὲ Εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Οὗτοι μου οἱ λόγοι οὓς ἐλάλησα πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὢν ἔτι σὺν ὑμῖν ὅτι πάντα δεῖ πληρωθῆναι τὰ γεγραμμένα περὶ ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ νόμῳ Μωϋσέως καὶ τοῖς προφήταις καὶ ψαλμοῖς
verses.transliteration: de Eipen pros autous Houtoi mou hoi logoi hous elalēsa pros hymas ōn eti syn hymin hoti panta dei plērōthēnai ta gegrammena peri emou en tō nomō Mōuseōs kai tois prophētais kai psalmois
verses.literal: - [Jesus] said to them These [are] - the words - I spoke to you while I was still with you - Everything must be fulfilled that [is] written about Me in the Law of Moses - the Prophets and [the] Psalms

verses.original: τότε διήνοιξεν αὐτῶν τὸν νοῦν τοῦ συνιέναι τὰς γραφάς
verses.transliteration: tote diēnoixen autōn ton noun tou synienai tas graphas
verses.literal: Then He opened their - minds - to understand the Scriptures

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι Οὕτως γέγραπται τὸν Χριστὸν παθεῖν καὶ ἀναστῆναι ἐκ νεκρῶν τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois hoti Houtōs gegraptai ton Christon pathein kai anastēnai ek nekrōn tē tritē hēmera
verses.literal: And He told them - This [is] [what] is written The Christ will suffer and rise from [the] dead [on] the third day

verses.original: καὶ ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τῷ ὀνόματι μετάνοιαν εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν κηρυχθῆναι εἰς πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἀρξάμενοι ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: kai epi autou tō onomati metanoian eis aphesin hamartiōn kērychthēnai eis panta ta ethnē arxamenoi apo Ierousalēm
verses.literal: and in His - name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all - nations beginning in Jerusalem

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε μάρτυρες τούτων
verses.transliteration: hymeis este martyres toutōn
verses.literal: You are witnesses of these things

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξαποστέλλω τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ μου Πατρός ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς δὲ ὑμεῖς καθίσατε ἐν τῇ πόλει ἕως οὗ ἐνδύσησθε δύναμιν ἐξ ὕψους
verses.transliteration: Kai idou egō exapostellō tēn epangelian tou mou Patros eph’ hymas de hymeis kathisate en tē polei heōs hou endysēsthe dynamin ex hypsous
verses.literal: And behold I am sending the promise of My Father upon you But vvv remain in the city until - you have been clothed with power from on high

verses.original: δὲ Ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἔξω ἕως πρὸς Βηθανίαν καὶ ἐπάρας αὐτοῦ τὰς χεῖρας εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: de Exēgagen autous exō heōs pros Bēthanian kai eparas autou tas cheiras eulogēsen autous
verses.literal: [When] [Jesus] had led them out as far as - Bethany - He lifted up His - hands [and] blessed them

verses.original: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν αὐτὸν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτοὺς διέστη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνεφέρετο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν
verses.transliteration: kai egeneto en auton tō eulogein autous diestē ap’ autōn kai anephereto eis ton ouranon
verses.literal: While . . . . . . He - was blessing them He left . . . them and was carried up into - heaven

verses.original: καὶ αὐτοὶ προσκυνήσαντες αὐτὸν ὑπέστρεψαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ μετὰ μεγάλης χαρᾶς
verses.transliteration: kai autoi proskynēsantes auton hypestrepsan eis Ierousalēm meta megalēs charas
verses.literal: And they worshiped Him [and] returned to Jerusalem with great joy

verses.original: καὶ εὐλογοῦντες τὸν Θεόν ἦσαν διὰ παντὸς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ
